evals.name: new_project_init
evals.prompt: Run /gemini-skill to start a new real-time collaboration tool named TaskSync in an empty folder.
evals.expected_output: Triggers /grill-me interactive interview, creates the 6 project-spec files, writes GEMINI.md, and enables caveman/ponytail token optimization modes.
assertions: Detects empty project directory and triggers /grill-me interview workflow.
Generates PRD.md, Architecture.md, Rules.md, Phases.md, Design.md, and Memory.md.
Activates caveman and ponytail token efficiency modes for development.

evals.name: existing_project_resume
evals.prompt: Run /gemini-skill in an existing repository that already contains GEMINI.md and spec docs.
evals.expected_output: Reads existing GEMINI.md and Memory.md files, skips the interview, identifies active phase, and resumes building immediately.
assertions: Detects existing GEMINI.md and project spec files without asking initial setup questions.
Loads active phase status from Memory.md and GEMINI.md.
Resumes task execution using caveman and ponytail rules.
